Class FaceppTemplate

java.lang.Object
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppTemplate
public class FaceppTemplate extends Object
Main entry point for the Face++ SDK. Provides access to face detection/analysis operations and FaceSet management operations.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
